data.title: Operating cost statement (Betriebskostenabrechnung) for 01.07.2024–30.06.2025
data.summary: Beispielelbe Immobilien GmbH sent the annual operating cost statement (Betriebskostenabrechnung) for your rented flat for the period 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2025. After deducting your advance payments, you owe an additional payment of €141.45, due by 11 December 2026; your monthly advance payments stay the same.
data.explanation: This is your landlord's yearly statement comparing your actual share of building operating costs (heating, water, waste, caretaker, etc.) to the advance payments you already made. You owe an extra €141.45 because your actual costs were higher than your prepayments. Pay this by the stated date; otherwise your landlord may send a reminder, which can add extra costs. You can ask to inspect the underlying bills if you want to check the calculation, and consider professional advice if something looks wrong. Your monthly advance payments remain unchanged for now.
